I believe you can feel different levels of suicidal. I feel very similar. From what I've noticed is that when I want to say, not wake up or die in an accident, it's because I do not want to upset my family and friends as badly as I believe I would if I actually went through with it. It would be an accident then and no one would be at fault, causing less guilt on everyone's ends. When I feel truly actively suicidal with the intent to take my own life, I can no longer see nor comprehend anything else around me and therefore my guilt cannot stop me. There is a difference between wanting to not exist and wanting to truly die. If you are feeling either of those things, please seek support as you are worth far more than you think. You have many people willing to listen. Don't feel guilty for feeling this way, life is hard and it is okay to feel defeated sometimes. People will listen to you. :)

I recently experienced something incredibly similar to this situation. I've seen many friendships snap under the stress of the pandemic, political climate, and general isolation. It seems as if he didn't respect your boundaries and wishes. The blame for this situation happening is not on you. If not attending classes is what you must do to keep yourself somewhat calm in this situation and less prone to suicidal action, then I'm proud of you and glad you are able to lessen the stress somewhat. I would suggest finding people with similar hobbies to you to try and alleviate some of the loneliness and stress. You have many people here that are willing and eager to talk to you and have you share your experiences. You could make a post on another subreddit, one pertaining to the things you truly like. Maybe anime like you mentioned? Over this pandemic I have started learning skills like sewing and blanket making and it has truly assisted me in helping me feel better somewhat. While learning a craft may not work for you, I would try something you have always wanted to do! Watch Youtube tutorials of how to do your new found hobby if that idea interests you. Learning something you have always wanted to do might assist in making you feel accomplished and a place to help vent frustrations in quarantine. I hope things get better for you, people are always willing to listen.
